item.title: 'Whenever I Get Booed, I Boo Back': Giannis Fires at Bucks Fans After Ugly Loss
item.description: Giannis Antetokounmpo booed back and flashed double thumbs-down at Milwaukee fans after they jeered the Bucks at halftime of a 139-106 rout by the Timberwolves on Jan. 13, 2026. The band is closing a major chapter, while the frontman prepares new solo projects. item.title: Greek PM Mitsotakis Commits to Farmer Support Following Tense Athens Meeting
item.description: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis pledged expanded support for farmers—including Europe's lowest electricity rates, elimination of excise tax on agricultural diesel, VAT exemptions, accelerated subsidies, and faster insurance payouts—following substantive talks in Athens, while firmly rejecting continued roadblocks and illegal protest tactics after 45 days of disruptions. item.title: Greek Aviation Chief Resigns Over Airport Radio Outage
item.description: Civil Aviation Authority chief Giorgos Saounatsos has resigned following a damning report on last week's eight-hour radio blackout at Greek airports, which forced airspace closure and widespread flight diversions. Investigators pointed to outdated, unsupported communications technology as a key factor. The post Greek Aviation Chief Resigns Over Airport Radio Outage appeared first on Greek City Times.

item.title: Russia Attributes Drone Strikes on Greek-Managed Tankers in Black Sea to Ukraine
